René Descartes

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / René Descartes / Q0330

English

I am, I exist—whenever it is uttered by me, or conceived in the mind, it is necessarily true.
Thinker René Descartes
School Rationalism
Source Meditations on First Philosophy II
Theme Existence
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Meditations on First Philosophy II, within the tradition of Rationalism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of existence, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In René Descartes's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
